definitions.explanation: The quality of being good; the good points or appeal of something. The noun form of the adjective {良|よ}い.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{良|よ}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}えたい→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: I want to convey the appeal of this town.

examples.japanese: ⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧みて、はじめて⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{良|よ}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧わかった。
examples.english: Only after trying it did I understand how good this tool is.

examples.japanese: ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{良|よ}さ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{時間|じかん}が{経|た}つ→時間が経つ：24138_jikangatatsu⟧ほど⟦{味|あじ}わい→味わい：11899_ajiwai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ま}す→増す：02422_masu⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The appeal of wooden furniture lies in how its character deepens as time passes.

notes:
The noun form of the adjective ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧ / ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (good), formed by replacing the final い with さ. Expresses the degree or quality of goodness, or the merits of something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {良|よ}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧: to convey the appeal (of something)
- {良|よ}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧: to appreciate the good points
- {良|よ}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|い}かす: to make the most of a strength

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{長所|ちょうしょ}→長所：03121_chousho⟧: strong point; merit — a specific good feature, more concrete
- ⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧: charm; appeal — emphasizes attractiveness rather than plain quality
